project_name: ApexNode Game Server Panel & Daemon Control Tower

layout_strategies.grid_system: Bento High Density Grid for Dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4)

navigation.sidebar: Fixed vertical panel on desktop (w-64), sticky header on mobile with glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/90 border-b border-[#2E364A])
navigation.pwa_bar: Mobile-optimized bottom bar for quick access to status, servers, nodes, and settings

server_dashboard.description: Grid & list view of game instances (Minecraft Java, Bedrock, CS2, Rust)
server_dashboard.cards: Card items with direct status indicators (glowing LED dots), real-time resource usage bars, quick start/stop buttons, player count badges, and node tags.
server_dashboard.filters: Search by server name, game type selector, and status filter buttons.

server_detail_page.header: Server identity with quick action bar (Start, Stop, Restart, Kill, Console, File Manager, Backups, Settings).
server_detail_page.live_console: Full-height terminal component with live streaming log view, ANSI color support, command input line, autocompletion, scroll lock, and clear logs CTA.
server_detail_page.metrics_panel: Real-time chart components showing CPU percentage, Memory allocation (MB/GB), Disk usage, and Network I/O throughput.

server_creation_wizard.ui_pattern: Interactive multi-step step-bar with live resource cost estimator summary card.

theme_customizer.features: Real-time live color accent switcher, border radius controller, UI density toggler, and light/dark theme toggle with instant preview and save persistence.

discord_bot_settings.features: Bot token input, server status webhooks configuration, channel binding mappings, prefix customizer, and test webhook button with live status indicator.

node_management.features: Listing connected Linux daemon hosts, CPU core count, total RAM available, daemon version, connection latency ping indicator, and Add Node setup script generator.

pwa_mobile_experience.features: Install prompt banner, swipeable server quick cards, compact live log monitor, and offline status fallback screen.

general_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="start-server-button", data-testid="console-input-field").
general_guidelines.alignment_rule: Do not center align the app root container (.App). Maintain left-aligned, structured command-panel flow.
general_guidelines.hover_contrast_rule: Always explicitly define text color on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-cyan-400) to ensure WCAG AA contrast compliance.
general_guidelines.accessibility_rule: All status indicators must pair color with textual or icon representation (e.g., green dot + 'ONLINE').
general_guidelines.animation_rule: Use Framer Motion or tailored CSS transitions for card hover elevations, status state transitions, and console log lines. Avoid universal transition: all.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the React frontend with Shadcn UI primitives customized according to the dark command tower theme.
Build out full interactive mock data state supporting server lifecycle actions (Start, Stop, Restart, Create, Delete).
Ensure real-time log streaming simulation with terminal line appending and command execution.
Provide live dynamic accent color updates via CSS custom properties when adjusted in the Theme Customizer.
Ensure all components contain explicit data-testid attributes for automated verification.
